name: Infosys
description: Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting, enabling clients in 56 countries to navigate their digital transformation.

name: Wipro

name: HCL Technologies
description: HCL Technologies is a next-generation global technology company that helps enterprises reimagine their businesses for the digital age.

name: Tech Mahindra
description: Tech Mahindra represents the connected world, offering innovative and customer-centric information technology experiences, enabling Enterprises, Associates and the Society to Rise.

name: Accenture
description: Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. It combines unmatched experience with Strategy, Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services.

name: IBM India
description: IBM India helps clients in digital transformation journeys, providing them with consulting, technology and managed services across domains.

name: Capgemini
description: Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology.

name: Cognizant
description: Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating and technology models for the digital era.

name: Amazon
description: Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking.

name: Google
description: Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful.

name: Microsoft
description: Microsoft enables digital transformation for the era of an intelligent cloud and an intelligent edge. Its mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

name: Deloitte
description: Deloitte is a leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax and related services.

name: KPMG India
description: KPMG India is one of India's top professional firms. It works with clients across industry sectors including banking and capital markets, consumer and retail, energy and natural resources.

name: Ernst & Young
description: EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. The insights and quality services EY delivers help build trust and confidence in the capital markets.

name: PwC India
description: PricewaterhouseCoopers provides industry-focused assurance, tax and advisory services to build public trust and enhance value for its clients and their stakeholders.

name: Flipkart
description: Flipkart is India's leading e-commerce marketplace offering over 150 million products across 80+ categories including Electronics, Fashion, Mobiles, Books, Appliances and Furniture.

name: Myntra
description: Myntra is India's leading fashion e-commerce company headquartered in Bengaluru, India. The company was founded in 2007 to sell personalised gift items.

name: Swiggy
description: Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands.

name: Zomato
description: Zomato is an Indian multinational restaurant aggregator and food delivery company. It provides information, menus and user reviews of restaurants as well as food delivery options.

name: Paytm
description: Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases.

name: HDFC Bank
description: HDFC Bank is India's largest private sector bank, offering a wide range of banking services covering commercial and investment banking on the wholesale side and transactional/branch banking on the retail side.

name: ICICI Bank
description: ICICI Bank is a leading private sector bank in India, offering a wide range of banking products and financial services to corporate and retail customers through a variety of delivery channels.

name: Axis Bank
description: Axis Bank is the third largest private sector bank in India, offering the entire spectrum of financial services to customer segments covering Large and Mid-Corporates, MSME, Agriculture and Retail Businesses.

name: State Bank of India
description: State Bank of India (SBI) is an Indian multinational public sector banking and financial services statutory body. It is the largest bank in India with a market share of over 23%.

name: Bajaj Finserv
description: Bajaj Finserv Limited is the holding company for the various financial services businesses under the Bajaj Group. It offers financial services relating to lending, insurance, wealth advisory and retail.

name: Reliance Industries
description: Reliance Industries Limited is a Fortune 500 company and the largest private sector corporation in India. Its activities span hydrocarbon exploration and production, petroleum refining and marketing.

name: Jio
description: Jio is a wholly owned subsidiary of Reliance Industries, operating the largest 4G network in India. Jio has become the largest telecom service provider in India.

name: Airtel
description: Bharti Airtel Limited is an Indian global telecommunications services company with operations in 18 countries across South Asia and Africa.

name: Larsen & Toubro
description: Larsen & Toubro is an Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing and Services. It operates in over 50 countries worldwide.

name: Tata Motors
description: Tata Motors is a global automobile manufacturer – of cars, utility vehicles, pick-ups, trucks, and buses. It is the 4th largest truck manufacturer and 2nd largest bus manufacturer in the world.

name: Mahindra & Mahindra
description: Mahindra & Mahindra is a multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. The company is one of the largest vehicle manufacturers by production in India and the largest manufacturer of tractors across the world.

name: Hero MotoCorp
description: Hero MotoCorp Ltd. is the world's largest manufacturer of two-wheelers, based in India. It sold over 6 million two-wheelers in a single year.

name: Maruti Suzuki
description: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is a publicly listed automaker in India. It is a subsidiary of Japanese automobile and motorcycle manufacturer Suzuki Motor Corporation.

name: Byju's
description: Byju's is an Indian multinational educational technology company, headquartered in Bengaluru. It was founded in 2011 by Byju Raveendran and Divya Gokulnath.

name: Unacademy
description: Unacademy is an Indian educational technology company based in Bengaluru. The platform provides learning courses for competitive examinations.

name: Ola
description: Ola is India's most popular ride-hailing platform. It allows users to hire cabs, auto-rickshaws, and other vehicles through its app.

name: CRED
description: CRED is a members-only credit card bill payment platform that rewards its members for clearing their credit card bills on time.

name: Razorpay
description: Razorpay is a payment solutions company headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It allows businesses to accept, process and disburse payments with its product suite.

name: PhonePe
description: PhonePe is an Indian digital payments and financial services company headquartered in Bengaluru. PhonePe was founded in December 2015 and is owned by Flipkart.

name: Nykaa
description: Nykaa is an Indian e-commerce company, founded by Falguni Nayar in 2012. It sells beauty, wellness, and fashion products through its website and mobile apps.

name: Meesho
description: Meesho is an Indian social commerce platform which allows individuals and small businesses to start their online stores via social channels.

name: Zepto
description: Zepto is an Indian quick-commerce company founded in 2021. It delivers groceries in 10 minutes via its network of dark stores across Indian cities.

name: Dream11
description: Dream11 is India's biggest sports tech platform, with over 200 million users. It offers fantasy sports for cricket, football, basketball, kabaddi and more.

name: ShareChat
description: ShareChat is an Indian social media platform available in 15 Indian languages. It was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Bengaluru.

name: InMobi
description: InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platforms for marketers. Through its products and solutions, it helps businesses and consumers have meaningful engagements.

name: Freshworks
description: Freshworks makes it fast and easy for businesses to delight their customers and employees. The company provides cloud-based software for customer engagement.

name: Zoho
description: Zoho Corporation is an Indian multinational technology company that makes web-based business tools. The company is known for the Zoho Office Suite.

name: Infosys BPM
description: Infosys BPM is the business process management subsidiary of Infosys. It focuses on integrated end-to-end outsourcing and delivers transformation through its full-lifecycle services.

name: Genpact
description: Genpact is a global professional services firm focused on delivering outcomes that transform its clients' businesses and shape the future.
